## Install

- **Windows:** run the `_x64-setup.exe` below. If SmartScreen appears, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** open the `.dmg` and drag Tightbeam to Applications. Open it once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.

Your chat history is kept when you install over an earlier version.
